courses.title: Independent Studies
courses.description: Creative projects, including research and design, which are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.

courses.title: Applied Statistical Process Control and Experimental Design
courses.description: Concepts and techniques of statistical process control and the design of experiments.

courses.title: Manufacturing Systems Planning and Control I
courses.description: Systems, components and configurations, flow of material and information in a manufacturing system.

courses.title: Manufacturing Systems Planning and Control II
courses.description: Flow of material and information in a manufacturing system; emphasis on systems integration.

courses.title: Manufacturing Processes of Materials
courses.description: Characteristics of materials with respect to their properties and associated choices of processing to create a range of products.

courses.title: Manufacturing and Supply Chain Strategy
courses.description: Strategic decision context of manufacturing and its supply chains with linkage to corporate and business strategy.

courses.title: Field Experience in Manufacturing
courses.description: Experiential learning through the firsthand study of manufacturing plants and by interacting with manufacturing leaders.

courses.title: Individual Studies
courses.description: Creative projects, including nonthesis research, that are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.

courses.title: Special Topics
courses.description: Formal courses given on a topical or special interest subject which may be offered infrequently; several different topics may be taught in one year or semester.

courses.title: Quality Management
courses.description: Concepts of design, assessment, and improvement of quality systems; customer needs analysis, identification of opportunities for application of measurement techniques.

courses.title: Design Practice for Manufacturing I
courses.description: Contemporary concepts in design and design practice with emphasis on engineering, business, and human strategic issues.

courses.title: Design Practice for Manufacturing II
courses.description: Contemporary concepts in design and design practice with emphasis on logistics, risk, design and manufacturing readiness, and production.

courses.title: Communication and Leadership Skills for Manufacturing Managers
courses.description: Applied principles of managerial, visual, and written communication that support the needs of manufacturing leaders.
